titleDv: ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޤާނޫނުއަސާސީ ... ވަނަ އިޞްލާޙު ގެނައުމުގެ ބިލު
summary: This bill amends the Constitution of the Maldives in three places: Article 73, Article 230 and Article 231. It replaces a paragraph of Article 73, adds a paragraph to Article 230, removes one item from a paragraph of Article 231 and adds a paragraph to it. The text appears to deal with seats held by people elected as a political party's candidates, but the scans are hard to read, so some details are uncertain. A table at the end sets the current text beside the proposed text for Articles 230 and 231.
whyItMatters: Constitutional rules on who keeps an elected seat could change, which would affect elected members and the voters who chose them.
keyProvisions: Clause 1 replaces a paragraph of Article 73 with new text.
Clause 2 adds a new paragraph to Article 230.
Clause 3 removes item (3) of a paragraph of Article 231, and clause 4 adds a new paragraph to Article 231.
Clause 5 is a transitional clause with several sub-paragraphs on how the Article 230 and 231 changes take effect. The scan is too unclear for details.
Clause 6 deals with when the amendment comes into force.
whoIsAffected: Members of the People's Majlis and local councils, and the parties and voters connected to their seats.
statedReasons: The explanatory note appears to concern how seats of elected members are treated, but it is too hard to read to summarise reliably.
